profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.heroTagline: 6 years turning complex problems into elegant, scalable systems - Python, healthcare interoperability and applied AI. Backend-first, full-stack when it matters.

paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer with a strong focus on backend development - with 6 years of experience shipping production systems, from data pipelines and clinical applications to full-stack products used by real communities. When the product needs it, I move across the stack to keep the experience coherent from infrastructure to interface.

The last few years have been remote, distributed and async - collaborating across time zones and cultures. Currently pursuing an MBA in Software Engineering with AI, deepening my work with RAG systems, agents and applied AI. Startup environments suit me best: fast-moving, idea-driven, focused on building things that matter.
Outside the editor: MMORPGs, music, and travel - pursuits that keep reminding me how exploration and persistence shape both personal growth and good engineering.

experience.description: Key contributor to MDIP - an EU-funded medication interoperability project enabling cross-border lookup of ~1M medicines across Europe, UK, Canada and the USA. Engineered large-scale terminology mapping pipelines (DM+D, SNOMED CT, ICD-10) processing millions of operations daily, and architected an Electronic Patient Record (EPR) system with intelligent clinical coding and oncology workflows. Achieved 100% release automation via Azure DevOps and Kubernetes.

Early-stage startup building e-commerce integrations between Omie and Shopify - automated synchronization of orders, products and financial data. First production exposure to async programming and Kubernetes at scale.

projects.name: Applika.dev
projects.description: Open-source platform for job seekers who want clarity and data in their search - track applications, follow hiring pipelines and surface real conversion analytics. Already in active use by 100+ developers.
projects.longDescription: My flagship open-source project, where I'm the main maintainer. Applika centralizes the chaos of job hunting into a single dashboard: track every application, log interview rounds, attach notes, and surface meaningful conversion metrics. Built to be self-hostable, contributor-friendly, and battle-tested with 100+ active users in a real developer community.
highlights: 100+ active users in a live developer community
Main maintainer of the open-source codebase
Multi-tenant auth with OAuth + JWT rotation
Kanban + analytics views over the same source of truth

projects.name: Poke RAG
projects.description: An Agentic RAG system that acts as an AI advisor specialized in Pokémon FireRed (Gen3, GBA).
projects.longDescription: A playful but rigorous experiment in agentic retrieval. Poke RAG ingests game lore, movesets, and walkthroughs into a vector store and answers strategic questions through a tool-using agent over WebSocket streams.
highlights: Custom embeddings tuned for game lore

projects.name: NowShare
projects.description: A platform that enables communities to create, share, and discuss content efficiently.
projects.longDescription: NowShare blends GraphQL ergonomics with REST simplicity to power community knowledge bases. Strawberry serves a typed GraphQL layer; SQLAlchemy + Alembic keep the data model honest across rapid iteration.
highlights: CI/CD via GitHub Actions to production

projects.name: Trello AI
projects.description: A modern Trello-inspired task manager enhanced with AI for smart planning and breakdown.
projects.longDescription: Trello AI takes a single goal and decomposes it into sequenced tasks, dependencies, and effort estimates - all live-collaborative through WebSockets and grounded by an OpenAI planning loop.
